rules.F1: Interrupt extraction to retaliate, then resume the original extraction unless superseded or dead.
rules.F2: Replace invalid enemy targets and all associated receivers together.
rules.F3: Effective damage may interrupt manual resource work; visibility alone may not.
rules.F4: New and retained target distances use the same concrete member.
rules.F5_R1: Reject or terminate impossible commands, release locks, tolerate numerical arrival error, and show command feedback.
rules.F6: Scan all valid visible candidates during patrol.
rules.F7: Attribute updates preserve skill cooldown and attack cadence.
rules.R2_R3: Range and obstacles constrain discovery and attacks; ranged attacks support vertical separation.
rules.R4: Use actual defense, complete unique risk candidates, concrete positions and extraction fallback.
